'''Shield Projector Relays''' were part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] system. The relays were part of the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] on craft such as [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]]. ''Imperial''-class vessels also had relays located on the main dorsal hull.<ref name="EGWT" />
